title: Demo arm still does not navigate vacancy-typed notifications, unlike the real arm
detail: The real arm's notification_target_path navigates for entity_type "vacancy" ("/vacancies/" <> vid). The demo arm routes only "application"; vacancy notifications in demo mode remain a no-op, so the two arms' click behaviour diverges.
recommended_fix: Add Some("vacancy"), Some(vid) -> modem.push("/vacancies/" <> vid, None, None) to the demo arm's navigate_eff case.

title: Live application deep-link only resolves when already viewing that exact vacancy's route
detail: The resolver requires the current route to be a vacancy route AND the loaded leaderboard to be tagged with that vacancy. Clicking an application notification from any other page (dashboard, comparison, edit) always yields None — the deep link silently no-ops in live mode except in the one case where the landlord is already there.
recommended_fix: Resolve from the tagged leaderboard even when the route is not that vacancy's detail page, or fetch the owning vacancy by application id server-side.

title: md:justify-end added to pipeline stepper rail but not to rejected/auto-closed rails
detail: view_pipeline's container gains md:justify-end; the equivalent containers in view_rejected and view_auto_closed were rewritten to the identical flex rail classes minus md:justify-end, so desktop right-alignment differs between pipeline and rejected/auto-closed states.
recommended_fix: Either add md:justify-end to the view_rejected and view_auto_closed containers or remove it from view_pipeline so all three rails align consistently.

title: vacancy_detail renders an empty class attribute when no comparison is active
detail: When comparison_ids is empty the div emits class="" — harmless markup noise, unlike application_detail which always carries "space-y-6". Minor inconsistency between the two parallel fixes.
recommended_fix: Omit the class attribute (or attribute list entry) when comparison_ids is empty, matching the conditional-only intent.

title: Demo banner comment says target was ~32px while the test comment says ~30-32px
detail: Component comment claims the CTA "was ~32px"; the test header comment in client_test.gleam claims "the demo CTA + Reset tap targets were ~30-32px". Trivially contradictory figures for the same change.
recommended_fix: Pick one measured figure (or a range) and use it in both comments.
